channel.title: Chad - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Chad, every source cited.

item.title: N'Djaména mayor joins cemetery cleanup
item.description: Djamal Yaya Moussa participated in a cleanup at Farcha cemetery ahead of All Saints' Day.

item.title: Chad launches national forum for traditional leaders
item.description: Traditional authorities from 23 provinces gathered in Mongo to identify causes of conflict and propose solutions.

item.title: Chad prefect urges peace between herders and farmers
item.description: Aboudeïa prefect Mahamat Ismaïl Hassan Kari met with residents in Am-Habilé on October 28, 2026.

item.title: Chad court sentences rebel leader to 15 years
item.description: The FDPC movement calls the September 9, 2026 conviction of General Abdoulaye Miskine a heavy blow.
